text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final preparations for the Sprinters Stakes:
the Senior Class Summer Training Camp begins!
As for Bamboo Memory—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!!!
I'm back here again!!
All riiiiiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!!
Please make this training camp ten billion times tougher than last year's!
I wanna break past all my limits!!"
choice_data_list: It won't be ten billion, but I'm gonna be strict!
It won't be ten billion, but I'll be strict!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the hottest, most awesome
summer training camp began!!
